race.description: Barlow & Peadon Schute Bell Mdn Hcp
race.comment: The raced have not done a great deal so WILD BOMBSHELL (10) will be one to focus on from a nice draw and a good trial. She is bred to show good speed in her races. Won't have to be too special to win this. LITTLE BUBBLES (11) got a bit tired late at Coonabarabran. Has been ok without being overly excitable. AERIALIZE (13) is one who takes up a position without too many issues. Could be one for the exotics. LONG LIVE (14) took on a better race two back at Newcastle and boxed on fairly. Something like that would make him competitive from the low gate. SMIDGEN (9) Palace Pier filly from Tinge on debut. Ran fifth at recent trial. Worth watching for any market confidence.
